question.problem: What is the result of dividing $\dfrac 3 x$ by $\dfrac {5}{y}?$
question.worked_solution:
To compute

$$
\dfrac{3}{x} \div \dfrac{5}{y},
$$

we just need to multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor:

$$
\eqalign{
		\dfrac 3 x \div  \dfrac 5 y&=\
		\dfrac 3 x \cdot  \dfrac y 5&=\
		\dfrac {3y} {5x}		
	}
$$
